properties.name: stx.amqp.enabled
properties.description: Open an stx-amqp connection at startup. Off by default. Unlike stx.jpa this really does open a socket at startup, so a broker that is not there fails the boot rather than the first publish.

properties.name: stx.amqp.uri
properties.description: Host, port, virtual host and credentials. The default vhost is named / while a URI path of / means the empty vhost, so amqp://localhost:5672/ authenticates against a vhost most brokers do not have and fails about permissions rather than about spelling. Write amqp://localhost:5672 or amqp://localhost:5672/%2F.

properties.name: stx.amqp.connection-name
properties.description: What this connection calls itself in the broker's management UI. Worth setting.

properties.name: stx.amqp.heartbeat
properties.description: What makes a dead connection look dead. Without it a broker restart or a dropped NAT mapping leaves a socket that reads as open and delivers nothing.

properties.name: stx.amqp.connection-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait for the connection itself.

properties.name: stx.amqp.recovery
properties.description: Reconnect and re-declare after a broker restart.
